title: SessionExport
description: A thin, validatable envelope wrapping one coding session's combined OTel telemetry (plan 047 Phase 1). Still OTel: `signals.logs`/`signals.metrics` are OTLP payloads regenerated FORWARD from the session's segments (Logs are the lossless substrate; metrics are derived, never inverted). Additive: additionalProperties:true + a pinned schema_version so a future report/RunRecord consumer never breaks on a new field.

schema_version.description: Pinned envelope version. Bump on a field-set change.

harness_session_id.description: Opaque per-session correlation handle — NOT an individual identity (AC-11).

harness_version.description: The producing CLI version, or null when a segment omitted it.

pij_session_id.description: captured_env.PIJ_SESSION_ID join key when present, else null.

branch.description: The git branch at capture, or null.

models.description: Distinct model names seen across the session, first-seen order.

kind.description: Where the segments were read from. Phase 1 = temp; git-ref is Phase 3.

root.description: The buffer location, repo-relative or a basename (never an absolute /Users/… path — P12).

segment_count.description: How many segments were combined into this export.

segment_schema_versions.description: Histogram of the schema_version of each combined segment (e.g. {"2.0": 40, "1.1": 3}) — records exactly what went in, including v1 (no-event_stream) segments (AC-02).

first_timecode.description: Earliest segment timecode, or null when none.

last_timecode.description: Latest segment timecode, or null when none.

tokens.description: Session token totals. `subagent_tokens`/`grand_total` are "unknown" (a string) — NEVER 0 — when any segment's subagent tokens were unknown (AC-10).

degraded.description: Field names that were absent / unknown across the session (e.g. "subagent_tokens", "plans_touched", "v1_segments") — surfaced honestly, never faked (AC-10).

signals.description: The combined OTel payloads. `logs` is the lossless substrate (one merged ResourceLogs, all events ordered by harness.event.t); `metrics` is derived FORWARD from the session rollup (one ResourceMetrics) — never inverted, never a sum of per-command cumulative metrics.

metrics.description: OTLP MetricsData — one session-level resourceMetrics regenerated from computeRollup(all events).
